certification.name: Advanced Red Team Operations Certification
certification.description: Covers C2 operations with Cobalt Strike and Havoc, redirector and cloud infrastructure, Active Directory and AD CS exploitation, lateral movement, persistence and EDR evasion. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam requiring C2 deployment, target compromise and flags, followed by 48 hours to submit a report.
certification.currency_note: Course with lifetime access and one exam voucher that does not expire; page shows 'starting at' USD 700
